# 07 — Three clubs

*Written by the suite from [`tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd`](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd). Every line under **What the suite asserts** is the name of a test that runs on every pull request, and its link is the assertion.*

Three clubs that are actually three clubs.

Until the range, `BallFlight` held one set of numbers for every full shot, so
every stroke in the game was the same club wearing whichever name the record
happened to store. These tests are what stops that quietly coming back: the
thing worth asserting is not any particular carry but that the clubs are
*separated*, that there are exactly three of them, and that every name the
record can hold resolves back to a flight.

## What the suite asserts

- [The clubs reach clearly different distances](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L14)
- [The short club goes up and the long one goes out](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L26)
- [The long club bends more](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L34)
- [A putt rolls and cannot be shaped](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L42)
- [There are exactly three](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L54)
- [Every club the schema names resolves](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L61)
- [The notation letters are distinct](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L71)
- [The flight model uses the club it is given](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L80)
- [A caller that names no club still gets a ball flight](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L90)
- [Asking for a putt gets a putt whichever way you ask](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L97)
- [The ai golfer plays the club it was handed](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L106)
- [The caddie reaches for a club that can get there](../tests/stroke/test_club_profile.gd#L129)
